verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only CLI-level handling of model assets: a fetch script downloads models into a target directory, each model is a self-contained directory, and adapters can be swapped or disabled via flags. Per-model tier settings are auto-detected from config.json. Nothing shows a unified place to manage models, prompts and configurations, though desktop apps are listed. Missing for 10: a central model-library/management UI, saved-prompt storage or management, user-editable per-model configuration profiles, and any hands-on corroboration.
